email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Social Media Manager role. Your ad asks for someone who owns their work, moves fast, and lets the data decide. That's how I already work.

At Episto, I handle SEO and content for client sites, including e-commerce brands like proteinbox.com.tr and Shopify stores harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com. I create content at volume, test what works, and use analytics to guide the next move. I also build and run my own sites, like baverok.com and mirook.com, where I shoot, edit, and publish content myself.

I'm fluent in English and live in Belgium. I don't have two years running social accounts for a drinks brand, but I learn fast, create quickly, and I'm not afraid to say when something isn't working. I'd bring that same energy to your clients.

I'd love to talk about how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Created and managed content for e-commerce clients (proteinbox.com.tr) and Shopify stores (harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com), including product catalogues and blog posts.
• Built and optimized websites for various clients, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles, using WordPress and Elementor.
• Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content creation, and audits, speeding up workflows.
• Ran SEO analyses and reported on performance using Google Analytics and Search Console, letting data guide decisions.
• Fluent in English, living in Belgium, with a technical background in front-end development and computer science.
